rulings.statement: A labelled bounded StarCi accordion gives every summary and expanded panel an inline inset of six and block inset of three.
appliesWhen: the accordion itself owns the bounded or elevated surface and an outside section label names it
doesNotApplyWhen: the disclosure is embedded inside another surface or host that owns its inset
the accordion does not own a bounded surface

rulings.statement: A labelled bounded StarCi accordion delegates summary inset to its trigger: one row uses p-4; first, middle and last joined rows use p-4 pb-3, px-4 py-3 and p-4 pt-3; expanded panel content alone uses px-6 py-3. A summary contract never adds a second inset.
appliesWhen: the accordion itself owns the bounded or elevated surface and an outside section label names it
doesNotApplyWhen: the disclosure is embedded inside another surface or host that owns its inset
the accordion does not own a bounded surface

rulings.statement: A bounded SurfaceAccordion is one joined list: only an inset separator divides adjacent items; an expanded summary and its panel remain one continuous item with no internal divider or hover fill. Panel content preserves either the canonical structured-list rendering or its supplied typed React render.
appliesWhen: the accordion itself owns the bounded or elevated surface
an item may disclose structured or custom authored content
doesNotApplyWhen: the disclosure is embedded inside a host that explicitly owns another interaction treatment
a visible rule belongs to content inside the supplied panel rather than the accordion item boundary

rulings.statement: A course curriculum disclosure preserves the complete module anatomy supplied by its product contract: the summary keeps module title, level and preview count, while the expanded panel keeps derived content count and duration, module description and ordered preview rows. It never projects that structured module into a generic title-description pair.
appliesWhen: a course curriculum module exposes level, content metrics, description and ordered preview rows
the curriculum is rendered through the bounded SurfaceAccordion owner
doesNotApplyWhen: the disclosure contract genuinely contains only title and description
the supplied panel is an independently authored typed React render

rulings.statement: A static supporting-text list uses a dot marker rather than a disclosure or navigation chevron, and every dot shares the exact semantic foreground tone of the supporting text beside it.
appliesWhen: the rows are non-interactive supporting statements inside authored or disclosed content
the marker only establishes list membership
doesNotApplyWhen: a row opens, navigates or discloses another destination
the ordered marker communicates step order or rank rather than simple membership

rulings.statement: Decompose each labelled feature section into its content and interaction facts before composition: one body uses SurfaceCard, comparable peer rows use SurfaceListCard, local hierarchical disclosure uses SurfaceAccordionCard, and one bounded form uses SurfaceFormCard; the section label remains outside its surface.
appliesWhen: a feature section label names a bounded body, collection, disclosure group or form
doesNotApplyWhen: the label is content inside an independently addressed document
no visual surface boundary exists

rulings.statement: One authenticated dashboard theme reaches chrome, routed content and renderer-owned portals in every supported theme mode; a portalled HeroUI surface never falls back to a vendor accent or mismatched ground/content pair.
appliesWhen: the addressed StarCi dashboard renders overlays, menus, drawers or popovers outside its local composition boundary
the dashboard exposes more than one supported theme mode
doesNotApplyWhen: an intentionally isolated embed declares and proves its own independent theme owner
the surface is ordinary content without persistent application chrome

rulings.statement: An authenticated dashboard or operational console owns one global navbar across viewports: product identity and context lead, only real global capabilities follow, and persistent destination navigation remains in its rail or narrow replacement.
appliesWhen: the addressed surface is an authenticated StarCi dashboard or operational console with persistent application chrome
doesNotApplyWhen: the surface is ordinary content without persistent application chrome
a proposed global action has no product behavior or data owner
a focused work surface explicitly owns and replaces persistent chrome

rulings.statement: Authenticated StarCi dashboard and console surfaces share one semantic theme topology across viewports and states.
appliesWhen: the addressed surface is a StarCi dashboard or operational console
doesNotApplyWhen: the surface is ordinary content without persistent application chrome

rulings.statement: Nivo keeps StarCi console topology while its profile alone owns the unicorn-red accent role.
appliesWhen: the routed profile is nivo-console
doesNotApplyWhen: the routed profile is starci-academy or another product

rulings.statement: Comparable peer rows sharing one boundary render through the StarCi surface-list owner.
appliesWhen: members are comparable peers and one boundary owns their separators
doesNotApplyWhen: members form parent and descendant groups or are interactive destinations

rulings.statement: A long parent-descendant collection with local disclosure remains one hierarchy and uses accordion mechanics.
appliesWhen: members form ordered descendants and each parent may disclose locally
doesNotApplyWhen: all groups must remain visible or members are peers

rulings.statement: Single-selection destination collections delegate traversal and activation to the ListBox owner.
appliesWhen: members are navigable destinations with one current selection
doesNotApplyWhen: members are informational peers rather than destinations

rulings.statement: A gated destination that opens an explanatory surface remains operable rather than becoming disabled.
appliesWhen: activation opens a viewable gate or explanation
doesNotApplyWhen: the destination is explicitly hard-disabled

rulings.statement: Within a navigation destination row, one semantically emphasized trailing lock, rank or due fact may use the chip owner.
appliesWhen: the fact is trailing navigation metadata and semantic emphasis is required
doesNotApplyWhen: the facts form a prose metadata sentence or more than one status competes

rulings.statement: Persistent content and project rails may resize independently from the routed body while keeping separate scroll ownership.
appliesWhen: a persistent adjacent rail owns independent scrolling and adjustable width
doesNotApplyWhen: the region is an overlay or binary collapsible navigation

rulings.statement: The StarCi collapsible navigation plane uses the evidenced compact inline and regular block inset.
appliesWhen: the owner is the shared StarCi collapsible navigation plane
doesNotApplyWhen: the owner is a resizable content plane or primary routed plane

rulings.statement: The primary StarCi learning plane owns its regular page inset independently from adjacent rails.
appliesWhen: the region is the primary routed learning content plane
doesNotApplyWhen: the region is a rail boundary or overlay

rulings.statement: The shared collapsible rail preserves its legacy width transition and reduced-motion behavior.
appliesWhen: the same rail host switches expanded and compact presentations
doesNotApplyWhen: the region is continuously resizable or replaced on mobile

rulings.statement: The StarCi collapsible rail ports the established SidebarSimple toggle owner and stable host rather than redesigning them.
appliesWhen: the routed source uses the shared StarCi collapsible navigation
doesNotApplyWhen: a different product profile proves another navigation owner

rulings.statement: A rail title appears only with evidence, and the collapse toggle keeps its circular ghost hit-area owner.
appliesWhen: the shared collapsible rail is rendered
doesNotApplyWhen: source evidence declares no rail title or the control belongs to another owner

rulings.statement: Compact icon-only navigation paints the interactive state on one circular inner owner.
appliesWhen: navigation removes visible labels and retains glyph destinations
doesNotApplyWhen: the destination keeps a visible text label

rulings.statement: Long repeating navigation groups use the scroll branch while controls and overview remain pinned.
appliesWhen: navigation groups exceed the bounded rail height
doesNotApplyWhen: the collection is short or the whole document owns scrolling

rulings.statement: Focused live evaluated work owns the viewport and restores persistent chrome only in its settled result state.
appliesWhen: the addressed surface is a live evaluated work session
doesNotApplyWhen: the surface is an ordinary route or settled result

rulings.statement: When persistent wide navigation becomes unreachable, mobile receives an equivalent distinct navigation form.
appliesWhen: the wide navigation is unavailable below its breakpoint
doesNotApplyWhen: wide navigation remains reachable or no destinations exist

rulings.statement: Deep paths use the compact back-link form when the immediate parent is the meaningful navigation target.
appliesWhen: path depth is three or more and one parent target owns return
doesNotApplyWhen: the path requires a visible navigable breadcrumb trail

rulings.statement: Responsive tab toolbars preserve independent semantic axes and give each axis its own overflow owner.
appliesWhen: two bounded tab axes represent independent choices
doesNotApplyWhen: values are inert facts or one axis has fewer than two choices

rulings.statement: Authored Markdown content uses one semantic document owner with safe extensions and local wide-block overflow.
appliesWhen: the surface renders an authored Markdown document
doesNotApplyWhen: content is inline rich text or ordinary UI copy

rulings.statement: Exactly one persisted primary continuation target keeps the established highlighted continuation surface.
appliesWhen: one target is singular, primary and persisted
doesNotApplyWhen: destinations are peers or no continuation target exists

rulings.statement: Stable product meanings missing upstream extend the StarCi Heroicons-compatible glyph owner.
appliesWhen: a stable product meaning has no faithful upstream glyph
doesNotApplyWhen: an upstream glyph exists or the mark is branded or ephemeral

rulings.statement: A protected product brand mark renders through its profile-owned artwork lockup and matching browser icon, never through a generic product glyph or heading-only substitute.
appliesWhen: the mark identifies the routed product in persistent chrome, a public identity surface or browser metadata
doesNotApplyWhen: the glyph represents a stable generic product meaning
the artwork is an ephemeral reaction

rulings.statement: An example demonstrates a situation but never becomes a family invariant without explicit scope and negative cases.
appliesWhen: feedback names a concrete value, label, status or visual treatment as an example
doesNotApplyWhen: the owner explicitly states a reusable invariant and its boundary

rulings.statement: A first-time action that starts new work remains an ordinary primary action and never claims the persisted-continuation highlight.
appliesWhen: the action requests, creates, enrolls in or purchases work that has not yet been persisted as unfinished
doesNotApplyWhen: the action returns the reader to one singular primary persisted unfinished destination
